prompt: I don't know why but I tend to feel very nauseous when I play Minecraft, even though there's billions of other games that I can play with loads more movement that you would expect to get the same response from, it doesn't happen there, almost anywhere in fact, but in Minecraft it's a common occurrence, if it isn't a thing every single time I turn on the game. And that sucks because I love Minecraft, but I can't play because of it. I also noticed that that doesn't seem to happen when I'm watching other people play, and that's also pretty odd.
response: It's quite unusual for Minecraft to cause motion sickness since it's not a fast-paced game. You might want to try playing with the graphics settings turned down to see if that helps. Also, taking breaks during gameplay might help reduce the symptoms. If the problem persists, it might be worth exploring other games that don't trigger this response.
